name: Cabarrus County, NC
findings: Cabarrus County has 632 nonprofit organizations. 251 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 174 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cabarrus County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 60 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 12 health care organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do health care organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Cabarrus County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list public events
observations.text: 3 professional organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through professional groups? Where else does that happen?
